title: Missing Panics documentation on rreq() method
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Line: 268

Issue: The rreq() method on RouteDiscovery<Searching> accesses EXPANDING_RING[self.ring_index] which would panic if ring_index >= 3. While the typestate design prevents this (ring_index can only reach 2 before advance_ring fails), the invariant is not documented.

Trigger: Cannot be triggered with current API since RouteDiscovery has private fields, but the invariant is implicit.

Impact: Future modifications could violate the invariant. A debug_assert or doc comment would make the safety property explicit.

Suggested fix: Add either:
- debug_assert!(self.ring_index < EXPANDING_RING.len()) at the start of rreq()
- Or a ## Panics doc comment explaining the invariant
close_reason: Invalid: rreq() method cannot panic - ring_index is bounded by typestate pattern and advance_ring bounds check. Max value is 2, array has 3 elements. No panic path exists.
